mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee (employee_account, employee_name, employee_gender, employee_age, entry_time, staff, employee_message, employee_password) VALUES (#{employeeAccount}, #{employeeName}, #{employeeGender}, #{employeeAge}, #{entryTime}, #{staff}, #{employeeMessage}, #{employeePassword})
mapper.update: UPDATE employee SET employee_name = #{employeeName}, employee_gender = #{employeeGender}, employee_age = #{employeeAge}, entry_time = #{entryTime}, staff = #{staff}, employee_message = #{employeeMessage}, employee_password = #{employeePassword} WHERE employee_account = #{employeeAccount}
